content.text: Same shape as fix versions: the read path is complete and there is no way to write.
- `search --jql 'component = SDK'` applies cleanly; components is filled on 4368 of 7163 live issues and 353 of 534 demo issues; the live changelog has 1924 component changes.
- web/src/components/detail/IssueFields.svelte:103 renders the components row with no edit mapping, so the detail pane shows them and cannot change them.
- issuetap has no components case in UpdateIssue (same Custom overlay as fix versions), GET /rest/api/3/component is 501, and GET /project/TAP/components is 404 (filed separately).
An agent can find the right bucket by query and then cannot put the ticket in it.

Fix shape: gadak edit KEY --component +Name / -Name with the same add/remove grammar as --label; the web editor gated on editmeta components.allowedValues like the other option fields; typed Components on the issuetap side if the write ships.
Gate: unknown-flag FAIL-first, then a PUT body carrying fields.components with resolved ids.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (track A, score 8/10).
